text: It is completely understandable that you feel hurt. When you open up about your feelings and expectations, especially regarding your friendships, it can be incredibly painful to have those feelings met with indifference or defensiveness. It makes sense that you would feel a sense of disappointment or a shift in how you view those specific connections, especially if you felt a deeper level of closeness with them.
